candidate_gate: Root freezes source, completes compiler and normal build checks, independently verifies source/binary/helpers/static requests, then authorizes each operation. No node while source changes.
comparison_rule: Use the frozen exact field projection and JSON types for every record. Normalize only optional key coordinates through existing logical.coordinates: absent/null range mean no range; empty string and whitespace remain exact values. No runtime-derived membership is permitted.
coverage_limits: Boot namespace-list errors, undecryptable enforcing records and wrong-key sentinel branches remain source/compiler checks. No corrupt homes or identity alteration are permitted.
The boot change preserves existing proof namespaces, the sentinel order and report-only behavior. Fresh startup and normal reopen are the only ordinary boot operations.
Removed plaintext twin loading has source/compiler checks; fresh native homes contain no legacy twin records. No migration or legacy fixture is added.
No performance or benchmark claim follows from these operations.
Timestamp runtime proof covers exact integer milliseconds and two fractional-second values around zero. No large timestamp matrix is added.

empty_hash_preload.scope: Only this primary bucket molecule is queried before the write. Other selected schemas remain unqueried. Empty hash and empty range are literal API values. The same EmptyRange durable batch runs once, here, rather than again in the later seed loop.

list.contract: GET response list has exact API hash/range strings, hash_filter and paging flags. It has no total_count. Compare unfiltered key sets without physical-key order; filtered one-hash pages retain ordered ranges. Each list call uses its ordinary public read scope.
list.cursor_contract: The public cursor is an opaque raw physical key. Only pagination copies a prior response cursor. This frozen dependency relation is required because a fresh home chooses private key material and molecule identities. Expected output membership is fixed independently of the cursor. Materialize and save the concrete URL before its dependent GET.

pagination.dependency_failure: If the baseline first page lacks a valid cursor, preserve that failure and record the dependent request as blocked. Do not invent a cursor or change expected keys.
pagination.label: list-filtered-second-page

pagination.dependency_failure: If the baseline first page lacks a valid cursor, preserve that failure and record this request as blocked. Do not invent a cursor or change expected keys.
pagination.label: list-mapped-second-page-refill

queued.addressability: Require the queued API pair in list before the frozen exact query uses that identical pair.
queued.lifecycle: Complete the four earlier narrow phases and normal stops first. Reopen the same owned synthetic home normally for the queued-write phase; flush and stop normally afterward.
queued.preflush_reporting: Record actual durability and accepted/completed sequences before write, after ack, after list and after query. Claim an observed pre-flush list/query only when the new accepted sequence remains beyond completed throughout the measured interval. If it flushes first, report that and retain the correct values; do not claim pre-flush proof.

expected.owner_text_contains: Invalid field: schema key list cannot recover a blinded API hash; provide a hash filter

list.transport: Every direct GET saves HTTP status, all response headers, and the exact raw body before any JSON decode. Plain-text refusals remain raw failures. Expected API keys, exact field values and typed values are literal; only a public opaque pagination cursor comes from a response.

narrow.contract: Records require exact API keys, field names, values, order, returned_count, total_count where declared, has_more, next_cursor and atom/molecule IDs. Batch independent normal requests. Admin-header requests use unchanged UnixConnection directly and retain raw outcomes.
narrow.mapped_wire_contract: FieldMapper serde into/try_from String uses sourceSchema.sourceField. No object form. Explicit source and destination use distinct hash fields.
narrow.metadata_scope: Every field requires atom_uuid and molecule_uuid. Runtime IDs do not define expected membership.

expected.owner_text_contains: LastDB does not support cross-hash PageAfter cursors; query one hash with a query cursor, or use Page with an offset

expected.scope: Omitted filter with the explicit administrative header exercises the initial unfiltered offset pushdown. Require one record, has_more true, and next_cursor null.

expected.owner_text_contains: Cross-hash query cursors are unsupported; use an offset or query one hash with a cursor

fractional_seconds.schema_type: No field_types constraint, as permitted by the existing ordinary declarative schema API. Values and JSON numeric types remain exact.

timestamp_contract.old_defect: The accepted baseline truncates integer milliseconds to one second; incorrect rows remain failed observations.
timestamp_contract.source_contract: schema/types/operations/mod.rs After/Before both include equality. Large integer values represent exact Unix milliseconds.

plan_freeze: Canonical version6 is frozen before all version6 baseline and candidate operations. It corrects only the supported list-envelope path from version5. Requests, projections, typed values, statuses, keys, conditions, pagination flags and expected membership remain unchanged.
procedure: Verify all frozen input and helper hashes and the private baseline program. Serialize the complete operations under the existing host lock.
Use separate fresh marked owned baseline and candidate homes. Use unchanged api.Node/default_node.start. Keep the same selected-schema environment before and after.
Declare independent schemas in parallel. Declare mapped A before mapped B.

Run the literal empty-hash preload prime and status before any seed. Run its one durable empty-hash batch, then exact statuses and post-write read. Preserve baseline status failures without replacement expectations.

Submit the remaining three prior durable batches, then all additional A-other, integer-millisecond, fractional-second, whitespace-hash and typed Hash batches. Do not repeat the already accepted empty-hash batch. B foreign rows precede A valid rows.
Flush and stop normally. Reopen, run the literal requests cold then warm. Stop/reopen normally and repeat cold then warm. Batch independent normal requests in at most16-item calls.
In the first cold and first warm phases, run the frozen list requests before query items. Copy only the public cursor for the declared dependent page and save its concrete URL before the GET.
Administrative requests retain their explicit header. Save status, headers and raw bytes before decode. Plain-text refusals compare the frozen owner text.

Compare Hash key coordinates through logical.coordinates, where absent and null range mean no range; empty string remains distinct. Preserve exact fields, types, order, counts, metadata and identities.

After all four narrow phases and their normal stops, reopen the same owned synthetic home normally. Issue the literal queued write, immediate list and exact query with native status observations. Then flush and stop normally. Do not repeat earlier counts after the added key.
Every baseline disagreement remains a failure. Stop the first unexpected candidate result and retain its original raw outcome. Never weaken expectations.
If all candidate narrow and preload checks pass, run unchanged cohorts.run once on a separate fresh candidate home.
Stop every owned node normally. Seal original receipts and results, prepare exact supported cleanup previews, and retain all roots for independent review before reclaim.
scope: Bounded ordinary synthetic API proof for round8. No new executable driver, validator, test harness, benchmark, existing-home load, primary, archive, cloud, migration, identity change or corrupt fixture.

supersedes.reason: Static envelope-path error: app_routes passes {list:report} to the flat envelope on both baseline and candidate. Version5 expected data.list.
